headline: Binance Details USD 6.3 Billion Exploit Stemming From Compromised Systems
summary: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches can significantly impact market confidence and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.
why_moved: A major exploit on a leading exchange involving significant funds draws immediate market concern regarding platform security and potential token liquidations.
